L76: # Billing for Xiaomi MiMo API Open Platform is Launching Soon
L77: 
L78: Dear Developers:
L79: Thank you for your attention and support for the Xiaomi MiMo API Open Platform. we hereby inform you that the platform will start billing at Jan 26, 2026 16:00 (UTC+8) , and before that, API calls will continue to be open for free, and the recharged amount or free credit will not be consumed for the time being. After the billing starts, accounts with insufficient balance will be unable to use the API.
L80: We recommend that you recharge in advance to avoid service interruption due to insufficient account balance.
L81: ### mimo-v2-flash API Pricing
L82: 
L83:   * Domestic: Input ¥0.7 / 1M tokens, Input (Cache Hit) ¥0.07 / 1M tokens, Output ¥2.1 / 1M tokens
L84: 
L85:   * Overseas: Input $0.1 / 1M tokens, Input (Cache Hit) $0.01 / 1M tokens, Output $0.3 / 1M tokens
L86: 
L87: ### mimo-v2-flash API Pricing
L88: 
L89:   * China: Input: ¥0.7 / 1M tokens, Cached Input: ¥0.07 / 1M tokens, Output: ¥2.1 / 1M tokens
L90: 
L91:   * Overseas: Input: $0.1 / 1M tokens, Cached Input: $0.01 / 1M tokens, Output: $0.3 / 1M tokens
L92: ### Exclusive Benefits Available
L93: 
L94: To thank you for your support, we have prepared exclusive free credits for all new and existing users. You can log in and go to cite37†Balance†platform.xiaomimimo.com to collect them.
L95: ### Recharge Rules
L96: 
L97:   1. Real-Name Authentication: Chinese mainland users must complete individual real-name authentication before recharging. Enterprise authentication is not yet available; please stay tuned for updates. Other users can recharge directly without real-name authentication.
L98:   2. Recharge Process: Go to the cite37†Balance†platform.xiaomimimo.com page to recharge. Chinese mainland users can use Xiaomi Pay, Alipay, or WeChat Pay. Other users can use common payment methods such as Apple Pay, Google Pay, and credit/debit cards.
L99:   3. Balance Inquiry: Recharged funds are generally credited to your account in real time. You can view recharge orders and bonus amounts on the cite38†Recharge Details†platform.xiaomimimo.com page, and check your current balance on the cite37†Balance†platform.xiaomimimo.com page. Once the billing system is activated, API calls will first deduct the complimentary free quota, followed by the recharged balance.
L100:   4. Invoice Issuance: Chinese mainland users can apply for electronic invoices by selecting successful recharge orders on the cite39†Invoice†platform.xiaomimimo.com page. Other users can download order receipts from the cite38†Recharge Details†platform.xiaomimimo.com page.
L101: 
L102:   5. For more details, please refer to cite40†FAQ .
L103: ### Contact Us
L104: 
L105: For assistance or business inquiries, feel free to reach out to us through the following channels:
L106: 
L107:   * Email: support-mimo@xiaomi.com
L108: 
L109:   * Scan the QR code at the bottom left to join the developer communication group
L110: 
L111:   * Submit your feedback from cite41†Contact Us†platform.xiaomimimo.com L112: 
L113: We are committed to continuously optimizing our products and services to provide you with superior AI capabilities. Thank you again for your understanding and trust!
L114:

L44: ## How Kimi Agent Has Evolved
L45: 
L46: On September 5, 2025, Moonshot AI released Kimi K2, an advanced mixture-of-experts model with 32 billion activated parameters and 1 trillion total parameters. For details, see the official website: cite42†Kimi K2 . Kimi K2 delivers strong benchmark performance across three core capability areas—Agentic Coding, Tool Use, and Math & Reasoning—providing a solid foundation for building general-purpose Agent capabilities.
L47: Guided by the principle of “the model is the product,” Kimi uses end-to-end reinforcement learning to train Kimi K2 as a native Agent, enabling it to work skillfully with more than 20 tools, including the file system, browser, terminal, code generation, image generation, and audio generation.
L48: On September 26, 2025, Kimi released its first Agent product mode: “OK Computer.” Unlike traditional manually designed processes and preset task workflows, Kimi Agent mode autonomously builds an internal knowledge system for “how to complete a complex task.” It can also adjust in real time to different situations, automatically choosing the most suitable tools and strategies to execute complex tasks efficiently.
L49: In Agent mode, Kimi autonomously plans and completes the entire process—from requirements research, product proposals, interaction design, and front-end development to final delivery—through multi-step reasoning and repeated tool calls. Kimi Agent helps users become full-stack knowledge workers and handle more complex tasks. Whether you are working on technical development, product design, or everyday office tasks, Kimi Agent provides efficient intelligent support.
L50: On January 27, 2026, Moonshot AI officially released Kimi K2.5. Kimi K2.5 is the most powerful open-source model to date, further expanding the applications of Agent mode. Benchmark evaluations show that Kimi K2.5 significantly improves real-world output quality and tool-calling efficiency in office scenarios, especially in structured outputs such as Word documents, Excel spreadsheets, and slide design, where it demonstrates end-to-end processing capabilities.
L51: Kimi Agent has learned the core skills for using Office software and supports end-to-end file output:
L52:   * Intelligent Word layout, editing, and review;
L53:   * PDF visual design and mixed text-image layout;
L54:   * Excel data analysis and financial modeling;
L55:   * Automated PPT generation and visual storytelling.
L56: 
L57: On April 20, 2026, Moonshot AI released and open-sourced the Kimi K2.6 model, bringing state-of-the-art capabilities in coding, long-horizon task execution, and Agent Swarm.
L58: Kimi K2.6 has been comprehensively upgraded across general Agent, coding, visual understanding, and other capabilities. It achieves industry-leading results on benchmarks such as the full doctorate-level Humanity's Last Exam, SWE-Bench Pro for evaluating real software engineering capabilities, and DeepSearchQA for assessing an Agent’s deep retrieval capabilities, matching or outperforming closed-source models such as GPT-5.4, Claude Opus 4.6, and Gemini 3.1 Pro.
L59: Kimi K2.6 is our strongest coding model to date, with a significant leap in long-horizon coding capabilities. In testing, it can code continuously for 13 hours, write or modify more than 4,000 lines of code, and complete the development and optimization of complex systems. By deeply integrating coding and vision capabilities, K2.6 raises code-driven design to a new level and can deliver professional-grade Web applications with highly creative design.
L60: Kimi K2.6 greatly strengthens autonomous Agent execution, helping us further expand what Agents can do. Powered by K2.6, the “Agent Swarm” architecture has received a major upgrade: it now supports 300 Subagent running in parallel to complete 4,000 collaborative steps, enabling larger-scale parallelization while delivering significantly higher task completion and output quality than K2.5.
